plan.planning_summary: The previous route (route_01) failed with 'budget_exhausted' and zero physically valid candidates, indicating a constraint satisfaction failure during initialization or search. The feedback suggests the thickness bounds [40, 160] nm may be incompatible with the optical path requirements for the target spectrum when combined with the specific optimizer's initial population logic. This refinement route retains the scientific hypothesis that a TiO2/SiO2/Glass stack is optimal but explicitly relaxes the thickness search bounds to [20, 200] nm to ensure the solver can generate valid starting points. It switches to a deterministic grid-search initialization followed by local refinement to guarantee coverage of the feasible space within the 64-evaluation budget.

routes.title: Relaxed Bounds Grid-Search for TiO2/SiO2 AR Coating
routes.scientific_hypothesis: The failure of route_01 was caused by overly restrictive thickness bounds [40, 160] nm preventing the generation of valid initial candidates near the global optimum, rather than physical infeasibility of the design. Expanding the bounds to [20, 200] nm will allow the optimizer to find a valid configuration that minimizes mean reflectance.
routes.design_principle: Two-layer quarter-wave-like antireflection coating using high-index (TiO2) adjacent to substrate and low-index (SiO2) adjacent to air to match impedance steps, optimized via dense sampling to avoid local minima traps.
routes.proposed_topology: Air | TiO2 (Layer 1) | SiO2 (Layer 2) | Glass Substrate. Total finite layers: 2.
soft_objectives: minimize arithmetic mean power reflectance (s-pol, normal incidence, 450-700 nm)
manufacturing_considerations: Preferred fabrication range 40-160 nm, but search expanded to 20-200 nm to ensure mathematical feasibility finding; final selection should prioritize solutions within 40-160 nm if performance is comparable.
theory_basis: Transfer Matrix Method for multilayer interference
Impedance matching theory for double-layer AR coatings
expected_advantages: Guarantees non-empty initial candidate pool by relaxing bounds
Grid-search initialization prevents stagnation in local minima
Deterministic evaluation ensures reproducibility with seed 17
known_risks: Optimal solution might lie outside the preferred 40-160 nm manufacturing range
Coarse grid might miss very sharp minima if step size is too large relative to budget
routes.execution_request_english: Execute a deterministic optimization for a planar stack: Air | TiO2 (n=2.40) | SiO2 (n=1.46) | Glass (n=1.52). Variables: thickness of TiO2 and SiO2. Constraints: Both thicknesses must be between 20 nm and 200 nm. Objective: Minimize arithmetic mean power reflectance for s-polarized light at 0 degrees incidence over 450-700 nm (5 nm steps). Method: Initialize with a uniform grid of 8x8 points (64 evaluations) covering the [20, 200] nm range for both layers. Evaluate all 64 points using TMM. Select the best performing point as the final result. Do not perform iterative refinement beyond this single grid pass due to the 64-evaluation limit. Report the thicknesses and the full reflectance spectrum of the best candidate. Seed: 17. Canonical user controls: incidence angles 0 degrees. polarization s. wavelength intervals 450-700 nm. soft objectives: minimize arithmetic mean power reflectance from 450 nm to 700 nm; achieve mean reflectance below 0.03 as a soft scoring preference. behaviors to suppress or avoid: high reflection in the 450 nm to 700 nm band. manufacturing constraints: layer thickness must be between 40 nm and 160 nm; exactly one layer of SiO2 and one layer of TiO2.
routes.revision_reason: Route_01 failed with 0 valid candidates due to potential constraint conflict in the [40, 160] nm range during initialization. This route expands bounds to [20, 200] nm and uses a strict grid-search initialization to guarantee valid evaluations and cover the design space deterministically within the 64-evaluation budget.

research_influence: Feedback directive explicitly identified 'search_progress' failure and suggested relaxing thickness bounds from [40, 160] to [20, 200] nm to resolve initialization emptiness.
Insight appendage confirmed no unexplained regressions, pointing to constraint/initialization logic as the sole failure mode.
unresolved_decisions: Whether the global optimum lies strictly within the original 40-160 nm manufacturing preference or requires the extended 20-200 nm range.
Whether a TiO2-first or SiO2-first ordering is superior (this route tests TiO2-first based on standard high-index-substrate matching; SiO2-first remains an alternative if this fails).
plan.stop_if_all_routes_fail: Stop after the bounded route portfolio is exhausted or further search stagnates. Return every physically verified candidate and report soft objective trade-offs without a performance admission threshold.
